scope: Complete author reading of all nine security-section pages, including the earlier identity review; source/workflow comparison supports diagnostic and release descriptions. Not an external security audit, deployment certification or final candidate campaign.

reviews.reason: Introduces integrated security controls and production prerequisites without treating diagnostics as certification.
Separates principal labels and credential normalization from authentication adapters, token issuance and durable replay.
Scopes metadata and helper enforcement to integrated paths, including custom route and ordinary-task responsibilities.
Requires trusted membership and restricted-role RLS; environment flags declare posture rather than create policies.
Identifies assets, actors and request/delayed/external boundaries, with explicit enforcement and audit limits.
Distinguishes example, framework-release and private application matrices; bounded tests are not exhaustive proof.
Lists actual release gates, static ratchets and manual publishing; environment protections must be configured and exact-ref checks verified.
Separates deployment and stricter release exit policies, configuration requirements and matrix assertions from executed application tests.
Separates discovery from execution, synchronous grants from durable decisions and MCP metadata from custom HTTP checks.
